records.text: Thomas Massie said he held a one-point polling lead after ten million dollars had been spent against him
records.speaker: Thomas Massie

appearances.snippet: It's a single point lead for me. ... They've spent... 10 million dollars against me

verification.notes: The full Tucker Carlson interview directly records Thomas Massie saying his internal polling showed a single-point lead after Carlson and Massie discussed roughly $10 million spent against him. This verifies the attributed statement, not the scientific accuracy of the private poll.

sources.title: Tucker Carlson: Rep. Thomas Massie interview
sources.relevance: Primary video records the single-point polling and roughly $10 million spending exchange.

records.text: Tucker Carlson said outside money had turned Thomas Massie's previously lopsided Kentucky primary races into a contest he could lose
records.speaker: Tucker Carlson

appearances.snippet: So it was 81% margin, 76, 75, like full on blowouts in the Republican primary in your district in Kentucky. And now it's within a couple of points and you could lose. ... The money poured into this race from outside of Kentucky is basically pushing you to the point of almost losing, and you may lose.

verification.notes: The full Tucker Carlson interview directly records Carlson contrasting Massie prior primary blowouts with the close 2026 race and attributing the change to about $10 million in outside spending. Current campaign-finance reporting independently confirms record outside spending in the race.

sources.title: Tucker Carlson: Rep. Thomas Massie interview
sources.relevance: Primary video records Carlson comparing prior blowouts with the close race and discussing outside spending.

records.text: Thomas Massie accused Miriam Adelson and allied groups of trying to buy a congressional seat in Kentucky
records.speaker: Thomas Massie

appearances.snippet: And so she's trying to buy a congressional seat in Kentucky, along with the rest of these groups that are probably, by the way, getting her money as well.

verification.notes: The full Tucker Carlson interview directly records Massie accusing Miriam Adelson and allied groups of trying to buy a congressional seat in Kentucky. The result verifies that the accusation was made and does not treat the rhetorical buy-a-seat characterization as a criminal finding.
